site.name: Space
site.what: OpenVibe's forums: public and members-only spaces, threads, posts, votes, categories and the Discord relay, moved off Community (plan T10, D1/D2).
site.description: OpenVibe.Space will be the forums of the OpenVibe network: create a forum for any topic, with the depth of classic boards like XenForo and phpBB, the feel of a modern community, and AI help for topics, research and moderation. The forums on OpenVibe.Community move here when it launches.

pillars.title: Any forum
pillars.text: Anyone can start one, for any topic.

pillars.title: AI assist
pillars.text: Topic ideas, research and summaries, always labelled.

pillars.title: One account
pillars.text: Your OpenVibe identity, everywhere on the network.

site.keywords: openvibe space, forums, create a forum, community boards, xenforo alternative, phpbb alternative
site.launch: the forum engine moving over from OpenVibe.Community

notes: Planned. Owns the forum subsystem moved from OpenVibe.Community (spaces, threads, posts, votes, categories, reactions, moderation, chat-room attach, Discord relay) in its own database ov_space; the community.space.*/thread.read/post.create capabilities are renamed space.* and the community.space/thread/post contracts are deprecated with space.forum-*/thread-*/post-* replacements (plan T10, D1-D3). The routes these capabilities name are served by Community today and move at T10 item 4.
